name: 晴空秩序
direction: A highly polished native Alipay mini-program design, calm sky-blue clarity and financial-grade trust without looking like a bank. Crisp 12–16 logical px rounded cards, balanced density, strong alignment, modern Chinese sans serif with medium headings. White cards on a very light ice-blue canvas; pure solid blue primary buttons. Signature: a precise three-node blue mesh mark and one understated connection line. Compact, useful, legible. No gradients as decoration, no cartoon, no glassmorphism.
